method: Executed: the unchanged EntityTrackerEntry (my) tracking a real server entity that runs its own onUpdate on a world double, and the same class as the client entity created from the packets the way NetHandlerPlayClient does (bytecode-read handlers replicated in TrackerItemsProbe.handle) and ticked with its own onUpdate. Bytecode-read: EntityTracker.addEntityToTracker table, EntityTrackerEntry.func_151260_c spawn packets, the S12 sent after a non-mob spawn, the client handlers.

bytecodeRead.spawn: EntityTrackerEntry.func_151260_c: S0E(entity, type, data): x y z = floor(pos * 32) (not the size class rounding), pitch/yaw (int)(angle * 256 / 360), motion (clamped 3.9, (int)(m * 8000)) only when data > 0. item 2/1, arrow 60/shooter id (own id without a shooter), snowball 61/0, egg 62/0, ender pearl 65/0, eye of ender 72/0, potion 73/damage, exp bottle 75/0, firework 76/0, TNT 50/0, falling block 70/(blockId | meta << 16), fireball 63. XP orb: S11(x y z = floor(pos * 32), value). After any spawn packet that is not S0F, sendVelocityUpdates entries send S12 with the motion.
bytecodeRead.client: bjb.a(fw): the entity from its constructor at pos / 32 (EntityItem and EntityXPOrb and EntityTNTPrimed constructors roll a random motion), serverPos = packet, pitch/yaw = byte * 360 / 256f, motion = setVelocity(packet / 8000) only when data > 0; bjb.a(fx): EntityXPOrb at the packet position, yaw 0. S14/S18 call Entity.setPositionAndRotation2 (no interpolation: setPosition + setRotation, then the box is lifted out of blocks 1/32 deep; EntityArrow only sets position and rotation). The client world ticks the entity with onUpdate after the packets.
